title: Pair Sum Indices
statementMd: You are given an integer array `nums` and an integer `target`. Return the indices of the two distinct elements whose sum equals `target`, smaller index first. Exactly one answer exists.

hints.label: Pattern Recognition
hints.text: This is a pair-finding problem on an unsorted array.

hints.label: Algorithm Choice
hints.text: A hash map from value to index gives O(1) complement lookups.

hints.label: Implementation Trap
hints.text: Insert after checking so an element cannot pair with itself.
